_note: The submarine HVAC combines a heater and thermostat combo along with a server that communicates over the air. The thermostat sends the termperature of the room to the server, which regulates the status of the heater (on/off). The server can do this because it knows the target temperature of the system. The server then sends the heater status to the heater thermometer combo, which enacts the command.
In this lesson you will learn the specifics of the HVAC system and how to change the temperature setpoint which the hvac system will try to stick to.

- Understand the variables which control the heating of the room
- Understand which variables are owned by the Client
- Understand which variables are owned by the Server
- Understand what the Client computes
- Understand what the Server computes
